cases.case_label: Novel mobile element in SPTA1 (spectrin Dayton)
cases.tsd: target-site duplication (length not stated in abstract)
cases.mechanism_detail: An insertion of a previously undescribed mobile element (TSD, long poly-A tail, no homology to known repeats) disrupts the alpha-spectrin gene and causes exon skipping, producing a truncated alpha-spectrin protein.
cases.quote: show that the alpha-spectrin gene is disrupted by a mobile element resulting in exon skipping.
